title: Import reconciliation D: G3 outcome recovery and serialized retirement integration
outcome: Under a hold, TermAl recovers every uncertain control intent only through exact typed reads (turn_grant_read, outcome_read) and Engram's writer-serialized retire_original, with zero provider sends on every branch. Anything not positively resolved stays pending.
acceptance: Tests cover every row of the packet's G3 table, exact identity, auth and schema errors, an unknown Evaluate without a grant, and the not_found versus late-Begin race in both writer orders. With retirement first, a late original returns a terminal refusal and creates no grant or begin. With the original first, the actual result is recovered and the provider is still never dispatched. A lost retirement or result reply retries the exact control outcome without a new effect. A completed grant with a pending process or report stays pending. Successful original execution is never inferred from retirement.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
